title: Visual Plant Imagery and Property Valuation: A Descriptive Analysis
authors: Yuqian Chang; Nathan M. Fong; Ning Ye; Maureen Morrin
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Cross-sectional hedonic regressions of log sale price (and days on market, views, favorites) on continuous counts of plant and non-plant images (plant_sum_gpt, nonplant_sum_gpt) with property, neighborhood, photo and text controls and zipcode FE (xtreg, fe i(zipcode)); robustness with zip3, geo-sector and realtor FE, CEM, DML and Frank's test. No treatment timing.
design_notes: Stata main_study/code_main.do (builds data(n=31031).dta from data_raw(n=40294).csv); SPSS realtor survey; Python DML notebook.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: cross-sectional; continuous plant-image regressors; zipcode FE; no adoption over time

data_files_note: README: identifiable variables masked; property and zipcode IDs randomly recoded and Gaussian noise added to log price, age, size and price-related variables.
data_provenance_note: Gaussian noise added to log sale price and other variables (masked).
screener_notes: Screened from package, README and OpenAlex abstract (no article text).
